intro: I'm a software engineer working across backend systems, data infrastructure, and automation.
Most of my work involves figuring out how things work, identifying what's making them unnecessarily complicated, and finding ways to make them better.

Sometimes that means building something from scratch. Other times, it's untangling an existing system, automating a tedious process, or making sure the next person who works on it doesn't have to figure everything out all over again.
I primarily work with Python and SQL, though I'm more interested in solving the problem than being attached to any particular technology.
Below are some of the things I've worked on.

paragraphs: Building and maintaining data infrastructure, internal applications, and automation for research operations. My work spans database design, backend development, data pipelines, and infrastructure.
I worked on a Flutter-based Quran application, building features such as prayer tracking, Qibla direction, and audio playback.
This was also where I gained experience working with clean architecture, BLoC, and maintaining a production mobile application.
I worked on Connected4Life, a healthcare application focused on responding to sudden cardiac arrest emergencies.
My work included QR code scanning, push notifications, API integrations, automated tests, and CI checks through GitHub Actions.
